verdict.rationale: LightSprint's docs say completed work becomes pull requests: the agent 'prepares for engineering review', and each pull request is tracked in Review Hub for readiness checks and merge. This implies agent tasks end in a PR, but no doc explicitly says the agent opens one automatically on completion, and none describes a setting to turn this on or off. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic PR creation on task completion, a configurable setting controlling it, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure an agent to automatically open a pull request when its task completes

citations.quote: LightSprint builds it, spins up a live preview, and prepares for engineering review.
Track each pull request in Review Hub, where engineers can check readiness and merge.
LightSprint tracks all PRs and manages ticket state
routine changes move from request to review with less manual coordination
